paper_name: A Scheduling Algorithm to Reduce the Static Energy Consumption of Multiprocessor Real-Time Systems
paper_description: Proposes MILP-based offline task to model idle time minimizing preemptions, and online extension of global EDF to lengthen idle periods, optimally reducing static energy via deeper low-power states.

formal_description.statement: Processor states S_k with power P_k decreasing, transition delay tau_k increasing; deeper k lower P_k, higher tau_k.

informal_sketch.intuition: Deeper sleep saves more but wakes slower.
steps: Choose S_k s.t. idle >= tau_k + next_release

formal_description.statement: MILP minimizes idle preemptions: min sum preemp_idle s.t. schedule feasible, idle modeled as task with EDF.

informal_sketch.intuition: Treat idle as schedulable task to cluster.
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
from pulp import *
prob = LpProblem('Idle_Min', LpMinimize)
# Vars: start_j, end_j for jobs + idles
prob += lpSum(preempt_idle)  # obj
# Constraints: precedence, processor alloc
prob.solve()
